# HONU MPC identification plots and spectral radii

- L-M identification plots use epoch number on the x axis for RMSE and weight histories.
- The weight ordinate is labelled as bold w.
- Ridge identification hides the RMSE-over-epochs and weights-over-epochs plots.
- Spectral-radius diagnostics are available for batch identification, frozen MPC, and sliding-retraining MPC.
- Batch identification displays the final spectral radii as identified-model points; MPC modes display their time histories.
- Full-screen plots retain the independent live line-width control without resetting zoom.
